descriptionMarkdown:
When the GM calls for a Requisition test, roll: d20 + proficiency bonus + relevant ability modifier + any Standing or 
circumstance modifier supplied by the GM. Success grants access according to the stated terms; it does not 
automatically mean permanent personal ownership.
Approach Typical Skill
Formal Request Persuasion
Locate Supply Investigation
Mechanicus Petition Technology
Religious Petition Religion
Black Market Deception or Investigation
Personal Leverage Any appropriate skill 
approved by the GM
